subject: Veridian Health: customer spotlight discovery — short interview scheduling

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Veridian Health: customer spotlight discovery — short interview scheduling

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for agreeing to do a short customer spotlight with us — really appreciate Veridian being open to sharing the story. We want to keep this lightweight: a 25–30 minute discovery interview with 2–3 folks on our side, recorded for internal transcription and to inform the case study draft.

Proposed agenda (30 minutes):
- 5m quick intros + context
- 10m how you use Redwood Inference in production (workloads, models, perf)
- 10m outcomes & metrics (cost/latency impact, team velocity)
- 5m follow-ups / PR permissions

Are any of these slots next week workable for you?
- Tue 12/8 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 12/9 11:00–11:30 PT
- Thu 12/10 14:00–14:30 PT

If none work, send a couple of times and we’ll adapt. Also—do you need a short consent form for recording? We can share our template; otherwise we’ll plan to capture the interview and send the transcript for approval before publishing.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Sr. Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: veridian_spotlight_brief_v1.pdf (brief agenda + examples)

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the note and the brief — excited to participate. Wed 12/9 at 11:00 PT works best for me. I will join with our Product Lead (remote) and copy our Communications lead if you need PR approval.

Recording consent: we’re okay with a recording and a transcript as long as we get to review any direct quotes used in the case study. Please send the consent template and the PR contact.

One ask: could you include a short sentence in the agenda for "data residency / compliance context"? Our security lead often asks for a quick mention of what data is processed by the vendor.

Thanks —
